title: HorseSpa Farm

services.name: Horse Spa Farm
services.desc: HorseSpa Farm is a unique boarding facility, catering to adult riders, located on 158 peaceful acres in northern Suffolk, Virginia. Since 2003 HSF has been meeting the true physical and mental needs of horses: fresh air, plenty of forage, clean water, shelter, room to roam, and the company of other horses. We also provide a state-of-the-art barn, and a safe, friendly environment where you can ride trails surrounded by fields and woods, or practice your discipline in our large rubber and sand arena, round pens, or grass arena. HorseSpa Farm is within 30 minutes of Hampton, Newport News, and Norfolk, and even closer to Smithfield, Chesapeake, and Portsmouth. We are located at 6100 Crittenden
